children: Nine addresses linked to an unidentified entity continue to hold long positions of 60,841.22 ETH and 600 BTC without reducing them, with unrealized losses exceeding $65.47 million. According to Odaily, the entity made more than $67.05 million from long positions between April and August this year, but has since given back all of those gains.

title: Entity’s Nine Addresses Hold ETH and BTC Longs With More Than $65.47 Million in Unrealized Losses
